title: 3.3.8b Lab — update() inside a class
description: Add an update() method to Planet that spins this.shape each frame, then call p.update() in draw().

steps.title: Add update() to Planet
steps.instructions: Inside the Planet class, write an `update()` method that increments `this.shape.rotation.y += 0.02` each call.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and look up the rotation property.

steps.title: Call p.update() in draw()
steps.instructions: In draw(), write `p.update()` so the planet spins every frame.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and review the update() pattern from the reading.

requirements.title: update() method is defined
requirements.description: Write an update() method inside the Planet class.

requirements.title: p.update() is called in draw()
requirements.description: Call p.update() inside the draw() function.
